m9w.core_finding: Better payoff comes from entry reclaim confirmation plus a separate profit-management vector, not from simply tightening the initial stop.
m9w.baseline_n3: n=1495 WR=62.27% PF=1.3659 avg_win=+17.20bps avg_loss=-20.87bps DD=510.5bps
m9w.loss_path: Losers average MFE only +6.05bps, MAE -43.67bps and hold about 251m versus winners MFE +23.85bps, MAE -12.83bps and hold about 127m.
rejected: simple fixed checkpoint MFE/time fail exits
m9w.entry_reclaim_reference: If first-turn bid is below PRIMARY bid - 0.10*M5 ATR14, wait up to 10 closed M1 bars for close reclaim then enter next exact M1 open; otherwise skip.
m9w.entry_only_reference: n=1054 ~25.1/month WR=62.33% PF=1.5875 avg_win=+16.37 avg_loss=-17.11 DD=358.9; all years PF>1; +2bps PF=1.2446
m9w.profit_vector: At native LONG_EXIT, if latest closed H1 MACD(6,13) still rises, treat native EXIT as partial-profit event and keep runner until first causal M15 RCI9 turn-down.
m9w.risk_vector: N6 H4 RCI9 percentile 25-50% remains half-risk sizing only, not signal suppression.
m9w.combined_75pct_runner: n=1054 WR=55.88% PF=1.6441 avg_win=+18.86 avg_loss=-14.53 DD=300.2 +2bpsPF=1.3195; true payoff ratio about 1.30:1
